documents.title: Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM

analysis.summary: California Software Company Limited issued its Annual Report for the financial year 2025-26 along with the notice for its 34th Annual General Meeting scheduled for September 29, 2026. The document details the convening of the meeting via video conferencing, remote e-voting procedures through NSDL, and specific agenda items including the adoption of audited financial statements. Additionally, the notice outlines the re-appointment of directors, specifically Mr. Duraiswamy Basuvaiah as an Independent Director and Mr. Vijayakumar Madhavan as a Whole-time Director.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that approximately 68% of small business owners reported using AI in the past year.
demand_outlook.quote: About 68% of small business owners report already using AI, up sharply from 51% just two years prior.

demand_outlook.claim: An additional 9% of small business owners plan to begin using AI within the next year.
demand_outlook.quote: An additional 9% plan to begin using AI within the next year, indicating that roughly three-quarters of small firms will soon be AI-powered.

capex_expansion.claim: The company invested heavily in AI-powered platforms tailored to small business needs during the fiscal year.
capex_expansion.quote: The Company invested heavily in AI-powered platforms tailored to small business needs, introduced affordable pricing models, and provided training and support to lower barriers to adoption.

orders_capacity.claim: The dSpeedUp digital ecosystem grew to serve over 1000 merchants with 95% annual client retention.
orders_capacity.quote: dSpeedUp’s digital ecosystem grew to serve over 1000 merchants, achieving 95% annual client retention as small retailers and service providers embraced the platform’s benefits..

risks_headwinds.claim: Many small enterprises still face resource and expertise gaps in deploying AI effectively.
risks_headwinds.quote: At the same time, many small enterprises still face resource and expertise gaps in deploying AI effectively.

risks_headwinds.claim: Industry surveys noted that 42% of small businesses reported lacking the necessary expertise or resources to deploy AI effectively.
risks_headwinds.quote: (e.g. 42% of small businesses reported not having the necessary expertise or resources to deploy AI effectively.

management_commitments.claim: Mr. Duraiswamy Basuvaiah is re-appointed as an Independent Director for a five-year term commencing from July 31, 2026 up to July 30, 2031.
management_commitments.quote: re-appointed as an Independent Director of the Company for a second term, not liable to retire by rotation, for a term of five consecutive years commencing from July 31,2026 up to July 30,2031.

management_commitments.claim: Mr. Vijayakumar Madhavan is re-appointed as a Director for a term of five consecutive years commencing from July 31, 2026 up to July 30, 2031.
management_commitments.quote: re-appointed as a Non-Executive, Non Independent Director, liable to retire by rotation, for a term of five consecutive years commencing from July 31,2026 up to July 30,2031.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that nearly 40% of small businesses plan to create new jobs in 2025 due to AI-driven productivity gains.
management_commitments.quote: around 80% say AI is enhancing (not replacing) their workforce, and nearly 40% plan to create new jobs in 2025 because of AI-driven productivity gains.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
